caption: Both hands work on an open black laptop base on a table. The fingers reposition and press small exposed internal parts, then move towards the lower edges to steady the chassis. The underside remains open throughout the clip; no cleaning, removal of a fan, closure of the case or successful repair is visibly demonstrated.

The left hand holds a small white cylindrical holder while the right hand rubs its rim and outer surface with a white tissue or cloth. The holder is rotated and tilted repeatedly so its opening and sides are exposed for wiping. A screwdriver lies on the table, but the hand-held wiping material is not a screwdriver. No finished repair or verified internal change is shown.

Hands hold a small brown cardboard carton over the lap, rotate it and repeatedly pick or press at an edge or seal with a fingernail. A printed side panel and a plain face are shown as the box is turned. A small light-colored tab is visible near the handled edge later in the clip. The box is not clearly opened, and the images do not establish that a seal is fully removed.

Hands repeatedly fold a long green paper strip around its already folded end, turn the small folded section and press new bends with the fingertips. The strip has a green face and a pale reverse that becomes visible as it rotates. Additional wrapped layers form locally, while a free length remains; a finished named craft shape is not required.

Hands hold a pink bead-counting rack while the right fingers slide colored bead groups upward along bent white rods and around their upper curves. Yellow, blue, pink and green groups are moved in succession so that fewer beads remain on the visible front sections; orange beads remain later. The rack is tilted and regripped during the manipulation.

The right hand holds a metal caliper while the left hand repeatedly takes small light-colored parts from a compartmented tray and brings them to the caliper jaws. The hands position and turn a part between the jaws, then reach back toward the tray for another. The footage does not provide a readable measurement or demonstrate a change to the parts.

Hands crochet a dark-red yarn piece with an colored-handled hook. The left fingers hold the existing looped work and guide the strand while the right hand repeatedly catches the yarn and draws the hook through loops. Several existing textured sections hang below the working area; a finished garment or exact stitch count is not established.

Both hands work on a thin golden cord above a low table containing other craft materials. The fingers pinch a small cluster of loops, feed or draw a cord segment through the cluster and pull the strands apart briefly before bringing them together again. The loose cord forms a larger curve on the tabletop. Close adjustments continue through the clip, ending with the cord still held. A knot-like or decorative loop structure is visible, but the video does not establish its exact knot type or a completed final ornament.

The left hand tilts a large translucent brown dish above smaller dishes on a dining table. The right hand uses a metal spoon to scrape and scoop its liquid and pale food remnants, moving the spoon toward a metal bowl below and a small white bowl with a reddish mixture beside it. Some residue remains in the held dish as the repeated transfer motions continue. The clip does not demonstrate complete emptying or a quantified rise in any receiving liquid level.

Both hands hold a closed blue-and-white rectangular printed carton above a wooden table. The front panel initially faces the camera. The fingers adjust their grip and rotate the whole carton into a more vertical orientation while the same main printed face remains largely visible. No flap is opened and no contents are removed. The scene supports packaging inspection by handling and turning, without identifying exact printed wording or confirming what is inside.

The hands hold a partly opened iron-like appliance above a table. A pointed silver plate initially faces the camera, then turns edge-on while separated from a dark inner body. The hands bring the corresponding rims close together and rotate the plate back to face the camera. Its external aperture pattern returns to view. The cream handle casing remains loose, and the later hand-supported alignment does not demonstrate locked fasteners, a fully assembled iron or successful repair. A grey-handled tool is also held in the right hand, without a verified fastening step.

Both hands hold a small stack of tan printed booklets or paper covers in front of a glass table. The fingers fan the left edges apart slightly, slide or align the layers and bring the stack together again. The same front cover stays facing the camera for most of the clip. No booklet is clearly removed, opened to a specified page or placed elsewhere.

The left hand supports a pale dough wrapper with greenish filling above a metal bowl. The right hand initially uses a small spoon near the filling, then both hands bring the wrapper edges together and repeatedly pinch short sections of the rim. The wrapper bends around the filling and develops folds as the fingers turn it. The final view still shows an opening; a fully sealed or finished dumpling is not demonstrated.

A short brown hollow cylinder containing thin wooden sticks stands on the table. The fingers repeatedly lift and turn individual slender sticks near its mouth while the other hand selects or aligns sticks from the nearby bundle. The cylinder remains upright and contains sticks at the beginning and later views; neither an exact increase in count nor a newly full container is established.
Hands hold an open transparent container of brown paste and use a metal fork-like utensil to scrape and stir near its rim.
Hands hold a black marker and its cap and bring the marker tip to the exposed ends of green cylindrical cells arranged in a box.

A person holds one hand with the thumb raised and works a long pale green nail file across the thumbnail edge with the other. Short back-and-forth filing passes alternate with small grip changes and brief pauses. The file and thumb remain close throughout the interval. The sequence shows nail filing without resolving a measurable change in nail length or final shape.

A person holds a pink-and-white flexible tube with its nozzle near a small white implement above a bowl. The right fingers squeeze and reposition the tube while the left hand keeps the implement under the nozzle. The working point is small and partly covered. The amount of dispensed material and a completed application are not clearly established.

On a white tabletop, a robotic arm with a black-gloved hand transfers food from a light blue bowl to a teal square dish. Initially, the blue bowl on a wooden board contains red cherry tomatoes and shredded green vegetable. The robot uses a white spoon to scoop the tomatoes into the teal dish. Subsequently, the robot hand directly grasps the shredded green vegetable from the board and places it into the teal dish alongside the tomatoes.

A pair of black-gloved robotic hands works over a white tabletop to transfer food ingredients. The right hand retrieves a white spoon from a brown cup and uses it to scoop two red tomatoes from a light-blue bowl on a wooden board into a square teal dish. The right hand then grasps a pile of shredded green lettuce from the board and places it into the teal dish alongside the tomatoes and spoon.

A robotic arm wearing a black glove works over a clean white tabletop, transferring food between containers. On the right, a wooden cutting board holds a small light-blue bowl with red cherry tomatoes and a pile of green leafy vegetables, alongside a brown cup and a white bowl each holding a white spoon. The arm uses a white spoon to move the tomatoes into a teal square dish in the center, and then moves the greens into the same dish, leaving the blue bowl and board in place.

A robotic hand wearing a black glove works over a plain white tabletop, transferring ingredients into a teal square dish. It uses a white spoon taken from a brown cup to move two cherry tomatoes from a light blue bowl on a wooden cutting board into the teal dish. The hand then directly grasps a pile of shredded green vegetables from the cutting board and places them into the teal dish alongside the tomatoes. A white bowl containing a spoon and white powder remains untouched on the table.

A gloved robotic hand works over a clean white tabletop, gathering food items into a single container. The setup includes a dark blue square bowl, a small white bowl holding a white spoon, a brown cup, and a wooden tray with a light blue bowl containing red tomatoes and a pile of green leafy vegetables. The hand uses a white spoon to move the tomatoes and then the greens from the tray into the blue bowl, combining the ingredients together.

A robot with black textured dexterous hands operates at a white table. The left hand approaches a small green bottle with a yellow cap lying on the table, grasps it, and lifts it. The hand then moves the bottle over a yellow perforated basket and releases it, placing the bottle inside. The right hand remains open and stationary throughout the process.

A robotic arm equipped with a two-finger parallel gripper grasps a green plastic bottle with a yellow cap from a white tabletop. The gripper lifts the bottle, transports it to the right, and releases it into a pale yellow plastic mesh basket, where the bottle comes to rest on its side.

On a white tabletop, a robotic arm equipped with a multi-fingered hand covered in black material performs a pick-and-place task. The hand approaches a green plastic bottle with a yellow cap, grasps the upper portion of the bottle, and lifts it. The arm then transports the bottle to a light green mesh basket on the right, releases it into the basket, and retracts, leaving the bottle inside.

A robotic arm with a black multi-fingered hand operates on a white tabletop containing a small green bottle with a yellow cap and a pale yellow mesh basket. The hand approaches the bottle, grasps it near the top, and lifts it while maintaining a tilted orientation. It transports the bottle over the basket, releases it so it falls inside, and then retracts from the scene.

A robotic arm with a black-gloved hand picks up a small green bottle with a yellow cap from a white table and places it into a pale yellow mesh basket. The hand approaches the bottle from the left, grasps the upper portion, lifts it, and moves it to the right. The bottle is lowered into the basket, released, and the hand retracts upward.

A dual-arm robot with dexterous black hands operates on a white tabletop containing a wooden paddle, a purple tissue box, and a blue bowl resting on a teal pot. The robot lifts the blue bowl with its right hand, retrieves a tissue with its left hand to wipe the bowl, and then retracts its hands.

A pair of black-gloved robotic arms performs a wiping task on a white tabletop containing a tissue box, a wooden board, and a blue bowl on a green pot. The right arm lifts and tilts the blue bowl, while the left arm retrieves a white tissue from the box. The left arm then uses the tissue to wipe the interior of the tilted bowl. Finally, both arms retract out of the frame, leaving the bowl tilted on the pot and the tissue box open.

A pair of robotic arms wearing black gloves operates over a white tabletop containing a wooden cutting board, a blue bowl on a teal base, and a tissue box. The right hand lifts and tilts the blue bowl, while the left hand pulls a white tissue from the box. The left hand then uses the tissue to wipe the interior of the bowl held by the right hand. Finally, the right hand places the bowl back on its base, and the left hand moves the used tissue away.

A pair of black-gloved robotic hands manipulates a light blue bowl and a tissue on a white tabletop. The right hand lifts the bowl from a dark teal pot, while the left hand retrieves a white tissue from a purple box and wipes the bowl's interior. The hands then retract, leaving the bowl resting on the pot.

In a kitchen-like setting, a white robotic arm with a black multi-fingered hand works over a light wooden table, with a blue cabinet and gray countertop visible behind. The arm's goal is to sort produce into a red plastic basket on the left. It reaches for a small red apple lying among an orange, a green pear, and a yellow banana, grasps it, lifts it, and places it into the open basket, then retracts with the hand open.

A white robotic arm equipped with a black multi-fingered dexterous hand picks a red apple from a white table and places it into a red slatted basket. The scene includes a blue cabinet in the background and other fruits (banana, pear, orange) on the table which remain stationary.

In a workspace with a white table, a robot uses its right multi-finger dexterous hand to manipulate a small orange cylindrical cup. The cup initially lies on its side on the table. The right hand approaches, grasps the cup, lifts it, and rotates it to an upright orientation. The hand then lowers the cup onto the table, releases it, and retracts, leaving the cup standing vertically. The left hand remains open and stationary throughout the process.

In a first-person view, a pair of white robotic arms equipped with black multi-fingered dexterous hands operates over a dark wood-grain table. The left hand remains open and stationary throughout the sequence. The right hand approaches a small orange cylindrical cup lying on its side, grasps it, lifts it, and rotates it into an upright orientation before placing it on the table and releasing it.

A robotic arm equipped with a black multi-finger dexterous hand operates over a light wooden table. The goal is to close a blue plastic pitcher containing a dark liquid. The hand approaches a small blue lid resting on the table, grasps it by the rim, and lifts it. It then positions the lid over the pitcher's opening and presses down on the top surface to seat it. The hand remains near the pitcher, with fingers extended, as the segment concludes.

A robotic arm equipped with a black multi-finger dexterous hand operates on a white tabletop. The arm's goal is to close a blue cylindrical pitcher. It first reaches down to grasp the matching round blue lid lying flat on the table, then lifts it and sets it onto the pitcher's opening, pressing it into place. Finally, the hand retracts, leaving the lidded pitcher standing on the table.

A white robotic arm equipped with a black multi-finger dexterous hand operates on a white table. The workspace contains a gray metal block with a central bore and a slender gold cylindrical rod. The hand initially grasps the rod, lifts it, and reorients it, but the rod is subsequently seen lying flat on the table. The hand then re-grasps the rod, lifts it into a vertical orientation, and lowers it into the central bore of the gray block. The hand releases the rod, leaving it standing vertically in the block, and retracts.

The wearer operates a white robotic arm with a black-gloved hand to stack small blocks on a light wooden table. The setting is an indoor workspace with a blue drawer unit and dark countertop in the background. The robot picks up small grayish-green cubes one at a time from the tabletop and places them onto a larger rectangular wooden block, building a short vertical pile. The arm repeatedly reaches, grasps, lifts, and positions each cube before retracting its open hand.

From a first-person viewpoint, a pair of white robotic arms equipped with black-fabric-covered multi-finger dexterous hands operates over a white table. The arms approach a yellow utility knife lying flat on the surface. The right hand grasps the knife body and reorients it vertically, while the left hand approaches to manipulate the slider, sliding the metal blade outward.

In a workspace with a light wooden table and a green rectangular mat, a pair of white robotic arms equipped with black multi-finger dexterous hands handles a screwdriver. The task involves the right hand touching the screwdriver's handle, followed by the left hand touching the metal shaft while the tool is airborne, and finally placing the screwdriver onto the green mat.

A pair of white robotic arms equipped with black multi-finger dexterous hands are positioned over a wooden table. A dark reddish-brown ceramic mug with a pale cream interior sits at the center, with a small brown lid to its left and a gray shelving unit in the background. The right hand picks up a slender metal spoon by its handle and lowers it into the mug while the left hand grasps the mug to steady it. The right hand then rotates the spoon within the mug to stir the contents.

A two-armed robot with white segments and black multi-fingered dexterous hands operates over a stainless steel sink. The robot grasps a red bottle with its left hand and a wooden-handled brush with its right hand. It uses the brush to scrub the bottle's surface, then releases both objects, leaving the bottle standing upright and the brush resting on the sink floor.

The robot operates at a light wooden table with a gray counter in the background. The goal is to apply soap from a blue-and-white dispenser to a yellow sponge. The robot's right hand first stabilizes the soap dispenser, while the left hand approaches and positions the sponge. The left hand then holds the sponge against the dispenser's pump nozzle, and the right hand presses the nozzle to dispense soap onto the sponge.

The wearer operates a pair of white robotic arms fitted with black gloves to manipulate two small black knobs mounted on a flat gray rectangular panel. The task takes place at a clean white table in a tidy room, with a blue cabinet and dark countertop visible in the background. The hands approach the panel from opposite sides, grasp each knob in turn, and adjust their positions before releasing them, leaving both knobs resting on the panel's surface.

The wearer is using a robotic arm to hammer a nail into a small wooden block. The task takes place on a large, flat white table in what appears to be a workshop or laboratory setting, with a dark gray cabinet visible in the background. The robot's right hand grips a claw hammer with a light wooden handle and a silver metal head, while its left hand holds the pale, rectangular wooden block steady. A single thin nail protrudes from the top of the block as the robot repeatedly strikes it.

A two-armed robot with white segments and black multi-finger dexterous hands operates on a white table. The robot uses its right hand to grasp a red-handled spoon, scoop a small white ball, and transfer it into a red bowl, while the left hand remains nearby.

A robotic agent with two white arms and black multi-finger dexterous hands works at a light wooden table, interacting with a camera. The camera has a black body with a silver top panel and a protruding lens. The agent uses its right hand to tip the camera over, then uses its left hand to lift and rotate the camera to view the screen and lens from different angles, while the right hand hovers nearby with an extended index finger.

From a first-person perspective, a pair of white robotic arms equipped with black multi-finger dexterous hands operates over a light wooden table. In the background, a dark gray counter holds white boxes. On the table, a tall red box, a small white carton, and a yellow-green tennis ball are arranged. The left hand approaches the ball from the left, flicking it to the right to move it past the white carton, while the right hand remains raised and open, hovering without interacting with the objects.

Two black dexterous robotic hands operate around a teal, square dish on a handled wooden board on a gray tabletop. The dish contains leafy green material, red tomato-like items and a white spoon with its handle pointing left. The right hand adjusts its grasp on the right rim, lifts the dish and holds it while the left hand takes the spoon. The left hand sweeps and turns the spoon through the contents, then lets it rest inside. The right hand lowers the dish onto the board and releases the rim; the spoon and food remain in the dish as the hands move clear.

On a gray tabletop, two black dexterous robotic hands coordinate around a teal dish containing leafy greens, red tomato-like items and a white spoon. The dish initially rests on a wooden board, with the spoon handle extending to the left. The right hand grips the dish's right rim and lifts it, and the left hand reaches across to grasp the spoon. While the right hand holds the dish above the board, the left hand moves the spoon through the contents. The spoon is released back into the dish before the right hand sets the dish down and both hands move away.

A teal dish holding leafy green material, red tomato-like items and a white spoon sits on a wooden board between two black robotic hands. The right hand makes an extended series of approaches and grip adjustments at the dish rim before lifting it. The left hand then grasps the spoon and repeatedly changes its angle while sweeping through the contents, with the right hand supporting the raised dish. After these stirring movements, the left hand releases the spoon inside the dish. The right hand returns the dish to the board and lets go, leaving the spoon and contents together.

Two black dexterous robotic hands manipulate a teal dish on a handled wooden board on a gray tabletop. Leafy green material and red tomato-like items surround a white spoon whose handle initially points left. The right hand spends several moments adjusting its grasp on the right rim before lifting the dish. The left hand then takes the spoon and moves it back and forth through the contents while the right hand holds the dish above the board. The left hand returns the spoon to the dish and withdraws, followed by the right hand lowering and releasing the dish on the board.
